complaint: Why is my bill higher this month?
expectedOutcome: A roaming event occurred in the previous billing period but was rated and billed in the current billing period.

complaint: My bill is higher than usual. Did I use more data this month?
expectedOutcome: Usage charges increased compared with the previous bill.

complaint: I was charged for a service I recently added. Why did my bill increase?
expectedOutcome: A newly active subscription contributed a recurring charge to the bill.

complaint: My discount is no longer showing on my bill. What happened?
expectedOutcome: A previously applied discount is no longer applicable for the current billing period.

complaint: There is an extra charge on my bill that I was not expecting.
expectedOutcome: A non-recurring charge was added to the current bill.

complaint: Why did the tax amount on my bill increase?
expectedOutcome: The tax component increased and contributed to the higher bill.

complaint: I think I have been charged twice for the same service.
expectedOutcome: Two bill items representing the same charge need to be identified and investigated.

complaint: My bill looks higher, but I want to know if the charges are actually correct.
expectedOutcome: The bill increase is supported by valid charges and no discrepancy is identified.

complaint: My bill increased significantly. Can you identify everything that caused the increase?
expectedOutcome: The agent should identify more than one contributing charge, such as usage and roaming.

complaint: Why is my bill higher? I do not have any other information.
expectedOutcome: The agent should request additional information or perform a limited investigation rather than invent a cause.

complaint: Why am I seeing roaming charges on my bill?
expectedOutcome: The agent should identify the roaming events and provide their event and billing details.

complaint: Can you compare this bill with my previous bill and tell me what changed?
expectedOutcome: The agent should compare billing periods and identify the material differences.

complaint: Why are my usage charges higher than last month?
expectedOutcome: The agent should inspect usage events and explain the increase using the underlying event data.

complaint: I do not recognize one of the charges on my bill.
expectedOutcome: The agent should trace the bill item to its related product or event and explain the charge or flag it for CSR review.

complaint: This bill seems incorrect and I want someone to verify it.
expectedOutcome: The agent should investigate available evidence and escalate when it cannot establish a reliable root cause.
